environment.description: Quarkus 3.2 serverless function deployed on AWS Lambda via quarkus-amazon-lambda-http extension. PostgreSQL 15 RDS instance with RLS policy: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON notes USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')). No output encoding, no CSP headers configured. API Gateway passes requests directly with default settings. Frontend renders /api/notes/search response via document.write().

config.deployment: AWS Lambda + API Gateway (REST API, no WAF)
config.rls_policy: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON notes FOR ALL USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant'))
